chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed, Allah the Exalted did not grant Satan authority over those who have faith.
But upon those who take him as their master.
ai.seo_question: Who does Satan have authority over according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifying that Satan's authority (*sulṭān*) is conditional, applying specifically to those who voluntarily align with him rather than being absolute over all believers. This distinction underscores the Shia theological principle of human free will (*ikhtiyār*), where obedience to Satan is a choice that elevates him to a master, while steadfast faith keeps him as a mere tempter.
